title: 추억과 꿈: 지난날을 떠올리고 앞날을 상상해요
objective: By the end, you can use 10 words about memories and dreams, such as 추억, 그립다, 간직하다, 상상하다 and 이루다, in short sentences about your past and future.
summary: Ten intermediate words for talking about memories of the past and dreams for the future.

task.title: Use memory and dream words
task.line: Choose, fill in or put the words in order, using the words on page 1 in the right form.

words.meaning: a fond memory (of a past experience)
words.example: 이 사진을 보면 제주도 여행 추억이 생각나요.
words.exampleMeaning: When I look at this photo, I remember our trip to Jeju.

words.example: 어린 시절에 할머니 댁에서 자주 놀았어요.
words.exampleMeaning: When I was a child, I often played at my grandmother's house.

words.meaning: (an idea or memory) to come to mind
words.example: 샤워할 때 좋은 생각이 갑자기 떠올랐어요.
words.exampleMeaning: A good idea suddenly came to me in the shower.

words.meaning: to miss, to long for (someone or something from before)
words.example: 혼자 살아 보니까 엄마가 해 준 김치찌개가 그리워요.
words.exampleMeaning: Now that I live alone, I miss the kimchi stew my mom made.

words.meaning: to keep something carefully (because it matters to you)
words.example: 친구가 준 편지를 아직도 간직하고 있어요.
words.exampleMeaning: I still keep the letter my friend gave me.

words.meaning: to look back on (a period of time)
words.example: 연말이 되면 한 해를 되돌아보게 돼요.
words.exampleMeaning: At the end of the year, I find myself looking back on it.
Try to picture yourself ten years from now.

words.meaning: to make (a dream or goal) come true
words.example: 열심히 노력해서 꼭 꿈을 이루고 싶어요.
words.exampleMeaning: I want to work hard and make my dream come true.

words.meaning: the future (one's own); 장래 희망 = what you want to be
words.exampleMeaning: When you were little, what did you want to be?

words.meaning: a wish (often made silently); 소원을 빌다 = to make a wish
words.exampleMeaning: I made a wish in front of my birthday cake.

exercises: Choose the right word: ① 고향을 떠난 지 오래돼서 가족이 많이 (그리워요 / 간직해요). ② 우주에서 사는 내 모습을 (상상해 봤어요 / 되돌아봤어요). ③ (어린 시절 / 장래)에 살던 집이 아직 그대로 있어요.
Fill in the blank with 떠오르다 in the past tense (polite -어요 form): 그 노래를 들으니까 대학교 때 일이 ____.
Fill in the blank with one word from the list: ① 동생은 ____ 희망이 요리사예요. ② 그 선수는 결국 금메달의 꿈을 ____. (use 이루다, past tense, polite)
Fill in the blank with one word from the list: ① 첫 월급봉투를 지금까지 상자에 ____ 있어요. ② 새해 첫날 해를 보면서 ____을 빌었어요.
Put the parts in the right order to make one sentence: 즐거운 추억이 많아요 / 되돌아보니까 / 지난 1년을
answers: ① 그리워요 ② 상상해 봤어요 ③ 어린 시절
